oneOf.title: Debug flags
oneOf.description: R: debug RNG, M: store photon trajectories, P: progress bar, T: save trajectory-only data

oneOf.title: Save detected photon flags
oneOf.description: D: detector ID, S: scattering counts, P: partial paths, M: momentum transfer, X: exit position, V: exit direction, W: initial weight, I: Stokes vector

OutputFormat.title: Output file format
OutputFormat.description: ascii and bin are accepted by mmc (mesh domains) only

OutputType.title: Output data type
OutputType.description: x: flux, f: fluence, e: energy deposit, j: mua Jacobian, p: scattering counts, m: momentum transfer (replay), r: RF mua Jacobian (replay), l: path length, s: RF mus Jacobian (replay), t: time-of-flight x scattering count, b: time-of-flight x path length

BCFlags.title: Boundary conditions
BCFlags.description: Up to 6 letters for the -x/-y/-z/+x/+y/+z facets (_: default, r: Fresnel, a: absorbing, m: mirror, c: cyclic), optionally followed by 6 digits (0/1) to enable photon detection at each facet

RayTracer.title: Ray tracer (MMC mesh domains only)
RayTracer.description: g: dual-grid DMMC (default; voxel volume output like MCX, forces BasisOrder 0), s: branchless Badouel (mesh output: values on nodes when BasisOrder=1, on elements when BasisOrder=0). On GPU workers p/h/b silently fall back to s

BasisOrder.title: Fluence basis order (MMC mesh domains only)

N0.title: Exterior refractive index (MMC mesh domains only)
N0.description: Refractive index of the medium outside the mesh

Omega.title: RF modulation angular frequency (MMC mesh domains only)
Omega.description: Angular frequency in rad/s for RF (frequency-domain) forward simulations; 0 = CW. MCX expresses this as Optode.Source.Frequency in Hz instead

Pos.title: Position
Pos.description: A single [x,y,z] or [x,y,z,weight] vector, or an array of such vectors to launch multiple sources simultaneously; Pos/Dir/Param1/Param2 arrays must have matching lengths

Dir.title: Launch Direction
Dir.description: A single unitary vector [vx,vy,vz] with an optional 4th element (focal length; "_NaN_" enables launch-angle mode), or an array of such vectors for multiple sources

Param1.title: Source Parameter 1
Param1.description: Source-type-specific parameters [p1,p2,p3,p4]; an array of such vectors sets per-source parameters when launching multiple sources

Param2.title: Source Parameter 2
Param2.description: Additional source-type-specific parameters [p1,p2,p3,p4]; an array of such vectors sets per-source parameters when launching multiple sources

ID.title: Source ID (0: launch all together, -1: save each source separately, >0: launch a single source)

AngleInverseCDF.title: Launch-angle inverse CDF
AngleInverseCDF.description: A monotonically increasing vector with values between 0 and 1, defining the inverse CDF of the launch zenith angle (x1 in x1*pi)

MeshNode.title: Mesh nodes
MeshNode.description: Tetrahedral mesh vertices, one [x,y,z] coordinate per node

MeshElem.title: Mesh elements
MeshElem.description: Tetrahedra as [n1,n2,n3,n4,tag] rows: four 1-based node indices plus a region tag indexing Domain.Media

InitElem.title: Initial element (1-based tet enclosing the source; -1: auto-detect)

MieScatter.title: Mie scatterers (polarized MC)
MieScatter.description: Per-medium spherical-particle properties for polarized photon simulations; requires Optode.Source.WaveLength

InverseCDF.title: Scattering-angle inverse CDF
InverseCDF.description: A monotonically increasing vector with values between -1 and 1, defining the inverse CDF of a user-specified scattering phase function (cosine of the scattering angle)
